title: Review: feat(backend)+feat(lmdb) pluggable store + LMDB + ctl CLI
notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — Four P1 issues, three of which cause silent wrong behavior: the /reload stub lies to the operator, S3/Filesystem unimplemented types can reach startup, and reader config lets the daemon start without any configured block store. The LMDB validation gap is a startup panic waiting to happen. Nothing that causes data loss, but operator trust issues.
Confidence: 20% chance of missed bug. Uncertainty driven by: (1) did not read transit/src/main.rs build_store() factory to confirm S3/Filesystem panic vs compile error — the issue is real but the exact failure mode is unverified; (2) did not read reader/src/main.rs to confirm how the reader handles no-backend config at runtime; (3) heed crate version not verified — unsafe impl Send/Sync on LmdbBlockDb may be genuinely needed if this heed version doesn't provide them. Would raise confidence with: 30 min reading main.rs factory functions and heed 0.20 source.
